title: Terraform behavior of ZPA-method forwarding rules
aliases: no longer an active Source IP Anchored App Segment

prose.text: {{zpa-retry}} The Private Access side of a persistent failure is in [[zia.forwarding-control.sipa]].

Other provider behavior for this resource: required and forbidden fields per method are in [[zia.forwarding-control.methods]]; predefined rule handling in [[zia.forwarding-control.predefined-rules]]; the gateway resource's read workaround in [[zia.forwarding-control.zpa-gateway]]; selectors the provider never sends in [[zia.terraform.field-fidelity]]; order handling in [[zia.terraform.rule-order]].
Older providers lack the Dedicated IP and GeoIP methods: {{method-version-history}}

checks.do: When a persistent failure carries the 'no longer an active Source IP Anchored App Segment' message, check the Private Access segment.

zpa-delay.statement: When a forwarding rule's planned method is ZPA, the provider sleeps 60 seconds before creating it. Up to v4.8.13 its update path also slept 60 seconds before invoking Update; from v4.8.14 the update sleeps 60 seconds, once, inside the step that writes the rule, and an update in which only `order` changed returns without writing, so it does not sleep. The provider's documentation gives the reason as letting ZIA and ZPA synchronize and replicate resource IDs.

quotes: // Sleep for 60 seconds before invoking Create
// Sleep for 60 seconds before invoking Update

func(pos OrderRule) error { req.Order, req.Rank = pos.Order, pos.Rank if forwardMethod == "ZPA" && !waitedForZPA { // Sleep for 60 seconds before invoking Update time.Sleep(60 * time.Second) waitedForZPA = true }
if !d.HasChangesExcept("order") { return ruleUpdateOrderOnly }
case ruleUpdateOrderOnly: log.Printf("[INFO] rule %s: only the order changed; leaving the move to the reorder engine", d.Id()) return nil
now pauses for 60 seconds before proceeding with the create or update process whenever the `forward_method` attribute is set to `ZPA`.
ensures that ZIA and ZPA have sufficient time to synchronize and replicate the necessary resource IDs

zpa-retry.statement: For ZPA-method rules, a 400 response containing "is no longer an active Source IP Anchored App Segment" is retried, up to three attempts in all, with a 30 second wait after each failed attempt, on both create and update.

the provider will retry the resource creation or update up to 3 times, waiting 30 seconds between each retry.

zpa-delay-expected.statement: A pause of about a minute per ZPA-method rule during an apply is the provider's deliberate 60 second sleep, not by itself a sign of failure.
zpa-delay-expected.conditions: Interpretation of the sleep claim. A pause well beyond 60 seconds per rule, or one with errors, is not covered; the retry path adds 30 second waits ([zpa-retry]).

method-version-history.statement: In the ZIA provider, the `ENATDEDIP` forward method was added to `zia_forwarding_control_rule` in 4.7.0 and its forward method validation was fixed in 4.7.4; the `zia_dedicated_ip_proxy` data source arrived in 4.7.9, and support for the `GEOIP` forward method in 4.7.15.

quotes: Added new `forward_method` `ENATDEDIP` to resource `zia_forwarding_control_rule`.
Fixed `zia_forwarding_control_rule` forward method validation for `ENATDEDIP`.
Added new data source `zia_dedicated_ip_proxy` for retrieving Dedicated IP Gateway information from the forwarding control policy.
Updated `zia_forwarding_control_rule` Included support to the new `forward_method` `GEOIP`.
